messages:
sara (marketing): Quick sync  launch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs links, bench snapshot, canary timing, and console screenshot for the blog.

anil (eng): Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/899. Minor note about quantized fallback in router.

rebecca (product): Reviewing release notes now. Webinar routing  use SFDC campaign `Q2-Launch-2026`.

lee (docs): Docs canonical URLs ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started and https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026. Added `quantized: true` sample.

sara (marketing): Need bench numbers for the post (median/p95 + cost).

anil (eng): Bench (dedicated): median 42ms/token, p95 185ms/token. Cost ~ $0.0019 per 1k tokens. CSV: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026-runB.csv

todd (ops): Canary plan: smoke 09:40 PT (5%), ramp 09:55 PT (30% 20m), full 10:20 PT. Rollback triggers: error-rate >0.8% for 4m OR p95 >700ms for 3x60s windows. I'll own watch.

sara (marketing): Can smoke be earlier so screenshot ready at ~10:05 PT?

todd (ops): Yes 09:35 PT smoke. Will add short-lived public snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/launch-2026/public-snapshot-10am (expires +2h).

lee (docs): Ill grab screenshot after smoke and redact IDs, upload to Confluence.

anil (eng): Dev note: cold-KV warmup can add ~150ms to initial tokens; fallback to `redwood-lite-2` if p95 >2s. Docs mention added.

sara (marketing): A/B headline ideas: A) "Predictable, fast LLM serving at scale" B) "Ship LLM features faster with measurable unit economics". Product pick by EOD pls.

rebecca (product): B is better with 'measurable unit economics' kept. Approved.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 1737778500. Image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026-canary. Logs: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1737778500

todd (ops): Enabled automated rollback hook on deploy-bot and throttle cap for first hour. Will post live status here during canary.

sara (marketing): Thanks everyone. Final check at 09:15 PT in #marketing. If no blockers, blog scheduled 11:00 PT with changelog + docs + bench table + CTA to webinar. :rocket:
